messages:
sam (AE): FYI we received an RFI from HelixCare asking for an on-prem POC with BYOH HSM, 7yr audit retention, and 80 QPS embeddings + 25 QPS gen. They want a capability matrix and ballpark POC pricing. Can we assemble a response by tomorrow EOD?
lee (Sales Eng): Quick clarifiers: 1) BYOH via PKCS#11 or KMIP? 2) Preferred region? 3) Sequence lengths for embeddings/gen?
sam (AE): They prefer PKCS#11, region is us-west-2, embeddings seq ~384, gen avg 200 tokens. No immediate FedRAMP requirement but they note it as future scope.
nora (Solutions): I'll build the matrix mapping their requirements to our support: private control plane, VPC peering patterns, BYOH PKCS#11, Redwood-managed HSM fallback, audit retention options, and performance caveats. I'll include an attachments list: BYOH playbook, sample deployment YAML, and a short test-plan.
ravi (SRE): Heads-up blockers: network egress rules and HSM latency (adds ~5-15ms per signing op). For throughput the safe POC config is 3 x A10x + tuned batching for embeddings. Peering setup may take 24-48h.
lee (Sales Eng): Pricing rough: 3x GPUs (2 weeks) = $14k, peering/onboarding = $2k, SE days (2) = $3k, audit storage incremental = ~$120/mo. I'll finalize after matrix.
sam (AE): Add a one-page summary for procurement. Also include fallback: if BYOH not possible for first week, run Redwood-managed HSM with customer-supplied keys and show delta.
nora (Solutions): Draft matrix ETA 4hrs. Example config snippet I'll include:
```
deployment:
  mode: private
  vpc_peering: true
  hsm:
    provider: "customer"
    interface: "pkcs11"
    endpoint: "tcp://10.1.2.5:7777"
  audit:
    retention_days: 2555
```
deploy-bot: artifact-uploaded: "BYOH-playbook-v3.pdf" to /internal/playbooks (link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/BYOH-playbook-v3)
ravi (SRE): I'll add a short test plan for the RFI to validate HSM ops/sec, p95 gen latency at 200 tokens, and embeddings QPS. Also note requirement to validate key wrap throughput.
sam (AE): Thanks everyone — please tag me when draft is in /sales/helixcare/rfi-draft. Need final packet by Friday COB. :thumbsup:
